description: Restructure the application layer from product->category to product->sub_category->category across all layers: new SubCategory model/repository/service/schema/route, rewired Category and Product models/repos/services/schemas/routes, blueprint registration, and the two new product-listing endpoints. Independent of FEAT-002 in code but must land first because the migration, seeders, and tests in FEAT-002 reference these new models, fields, and endpoints. Leaves the app importable and the existing (pre-migration) tests updated-by-FEAT-002 — within this FEAT, verify by import sanity and targeted unit tests with repos mocked.
steps: Create app/models/sub_categories.py mirroring app/models/categories.py. Class SubCategory, __tablename__='sub_categories', __table_args__ with UniqueConstraint('name', name='uq_sub_categories_name'). Columns: id PK; category_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('categories.id', ondelete='SET NULL', name='fk_sub_categories_category_id'), index=True); name String(255) nullable=False; created_at DateTime default utcnow (from app.utils.timezone import utcnow); is_active Boolean default True nullable=False. Relationships: category = db.relationship('Category', backref='sub_categories', lazy=True); products = db.relationship('Product', backref='sub_category', lazy=True). Add to_dict() (id, name, category_id, created_at iso, is_active) and to_dict_detail() nesting the parent category via self.category.to_dict().

Edit app/models/categories.py: delete the `products = db.relationship('Product', backref='category', lazy=True)` line (the sub_categories collection is provided by SubCategory's backref defined in the previous step). Update to_dict_with_products() to gather products through sub_categories: iterate self.sub_categories and their active products; keep to_dict()/to_dict_detail() shape, and expose a sub_categories listing in detail.

Edit app/models/products.py: rename column category_id to sub_category_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('sub_categories.id', ondelete='SET NULL', name='fk_products_sub_category_id'), index=True). Remove any reliance on the old `category` relationship. Change to_dict_detail() to emit the sub_category (self.sub_category.to_dict_detail() if present, exposing its parent category) instead of self.category; keep to_dict, images, primary_image, active_images unchanged.
Edit app/models/__init__.py: add `from app.models.sub_categories import SubCategory` and add 'SubCategory' to __all__.

Create app/repositories/sub_category_repository.py mirroring app/repositories/category_repository.py: get_all(filters, sort_by='id', order='asc', page=1, limit=10) filtering is_active=True with a name ilike filter AND a category_id equality filter when filters['category_id'] is set; sort_columns for id/name/created_at; return query.paginate(page=page, per_page=limit, error_out=False). Also get_by_id, find_by_name(name, exclude_id=None), create(data) setting name and category_id, update, soft_delete, and get_by_category_id(category_id) returning active sub-categories for a category.

Edit app/repositories/product_repository.py: in get_all replace the category_id filter branch with sub_category_id; in create() replace category_id=data.get('category_id') with sub_category_id=data.get('sub_category_id'); in update() replace the 'category_id' branch with 'sub_category_id'. Add get_by_sub_category_id(sub_category_id, sort_by='id', order='asc', page=1, limit=10) filtering Product.sub_category_id and is_active=True with the same sort/paginate as get_all. Add get_by_category_id(category_id, sort_by='id', order='asc', page=1, limit=10) that joins Product to SubCategory on Product.sub_category_id==SubCategory.id, filters SubCategory.category_id==category_id, Product.is_active==True and SubCategory.is_active==True, with the same sort/paginate. Import SubCategory from app.models.sub_categories.

Create app/services/sub_category_service.py mirroring app/services/category_service.py: define SubCategoryNotFoundError and SubCategoryNameExistsError. get_all passthrough to repo. get_by_id raises SubCategoryNotFoundError when missing. create(data): validate parent category exists and is_active via CategoryRepository.get_by_id(data['category_id']) and raise CategoryNotFoundError (imported from app.services.category_service) if not found; check duplicate name via SubCategoryRepository.find_by_name and raise SubCategoryNameExistsError; else create. update(sub_category_id, data) mirrors category update (not-found, no-op when all None, duplicate-name exclude self). delete(sub_category_id) soft-deletes.

Edit app/services/product_service.py: add SubCategoryNotFoundError. Replace Category validation in create() and update() with: when data.get('sub_category_id') is set, look up an active SubCategory (SubCategory.query.filter_by(id=..., is_active=True).first()) and raise SubCategoryNotFoundError('sub category id not found') if missing. Import SubCategory from app.models.sub_categories. Keep CategoryNotFoundError defined in the module OR remove it and update the route import in the next step; choose to KEEP CategoryNotFoundError defined (harmless) and ALSO add SubCategoryNotFoundError, then update the route to catch SubCategoryNotFoundError.

Edit app/routes/products.py: update the import from app.services.product_service to include SubCategoryNotFoundError; in ProductList.post and ProductDetail.put, catch SubCategoryNotFoundError and abort(404, message=str(e)) (keep the existing CategoryNotFoundError except clause too, or replace it with SubCategoryNotFoundError). In ProductList.get change the filters dict key 'category_id' to 'sub_category_id' reading query_params.get('sub_category_id').

Create app/schemas/sub_category_schema.py mirroring app/schemas/category_schema.py: SubCategoryQuerySchema (name load_default None, category_id Integer load_default None, sort_by OneOf id/name/created_at, order, page, limit). CreateSubCategorySchema (name required with length/error_messages + strip_name pre_load; category_id Integer required with error_messages). UpdateSubCategorySchema (name + category_id optional). SubCategoryResponseSchema (id, name, category_id, created_at iso, is_active). SubCategoryDetailResponseSchema (nested parent category via CategoryResponseSchema and optional products list).

Edit app/schemas/product_schema.py: rename category_id to sub_category_id in ProductQuerySchema, CreateProductSchema, UpdateProductSchema (preserve error_messages/@validates/@pre_load style). In ProductDetailResponseSchema, replace the `category = fields.Nested(CategoryResponseSchema, allow_none=True)` field with `sub_category = fields.Nested(SubCategoryInProductSchema, allow_none=True)` where SubCategoryInProductSchema (new, in this file) exposes id, name, category_id and a nested parent category via CategoryResponseSchema.

Create app/routes/sub_categories.py mirroring app/routes/categories.py: sub_categories_blp = Blueprint('sub_categories', __name__, url_prefix='/api/v1/sub-categories', description='Sub-category operations'). Route '/' SubCategoryList: get (public, SubCategoryQuerySchema query args, name + category_id filters, SubCategoryService.get_all, make_response + paginate_meta with SubCategoryResponseSchema(many=True)); post (@roles_required('seller','admin'), CreateSubCategorySchema, catch SubCategoryNameExistsError->409 and CategoryNotFoundError->404). Route '/<int:sub_category_id>' SubCategoryDetail: get (SubCategoryDetailResponseSchema, 404), put (@roles_required, UpdateSubCategorySchema, 404/409), delete (@roles_required, 404). Route '/<int:sub_category_id>/products' SubCategoryProducts: get (public) calling ProductRepository.get_by_sub_category_id via a ProductService method, returning ProductResponseSchema(many=True) + paginate_meta.

Edit app/routes/categories.py: add a MethodView mapped to '/<int:category_id>/products-by-category' (public GET, paginated). It validates the category exists (CategoryService.get_by_id, abort 404 on CategoryNotFoundError), then returns products via ProductRepository.get_by_category_id(category_id, ...) wrapped by a ProductService method, dumped with ProductResponseSchema(many=True) + paginate_meta. Accept page/limit/sort/order query params (reuse a query schema or read request args consistently with the existing style).

Add thin ProductService passthrough methods used by the two new endpoints, e.g. ProductService.get_by_sub_category_id(...) and ProductService.get_by_category_id(...) delegating to the matching ProductRepository methods, so routes call the service layer (consistent with the architecture).

Edit app/__init__.py: add `from app.routes.sub_categories import sub_categories_blp` with the other route imports (around lines 37-48) and `api.register_blueprint(sub_categories_blp)` with the other registrations (around lines 48-58). Do NOT modify app/routes/__init__.py.
acceptance_criteria: `source .venv/bin/activate && python -c "from app import create_app; create_app()"` runs with no import or SQLAlchemy mapper errors.

`source .venv/bin/activate && FLASK_APP=run.py flask routes` lists the sub-categories CRUD routes, GET /api/v1/sub-categories/<int:sub_category_id>/products, and GET /api/v1/categories/<int:category_id>/products-by-category.
The Product model exposes sub_category_id (not category_id) and ProductDetailResponseSchema serializes a sub_category object with a nested parent category.

ProductService raises SubCategoryNotFoundError for an invalid sub_category_id on create/update; SubCategoryService raises CategoryNotFoundError when the parent category is missing/inactive and SubCategoryNameExistsError on duplicate names.
verification: source .venv/bin/activate && python -c "from app import create_app; create_app(); print('ok')"

source .venv/bin/activate && python -c "import app.models.sub_categories, app.repositories.sub_category_repository, app.services.sub_category_service, app.schemas.sub_category_schema, app.routes.sub_categories; print('imports ok')"
findings:
Implemented and verified (all three verification commands pass: create_app() ok, flask routes shows the new routes, module imports ok). Notes for FEAT-002:

Schema / DB fields: products.category_id was renamed to products.sub_category_id, FK -> sub_categories.id, ondelete='SET NULL', constraint name 'fk_products_sub_category_id', index=True. New table sub_categories: columns id PK, category_id (FK categories.id, ondelete='SET NULL', name 'fk_sub_categories_category_id', index=True, nullable), name String(255) NOT NULL, created_at DateTime, is_active Boolean NOT NULL default True; UniqueConstraint('name', name='uq_sub_categories_name'). Migration down_revision is e14203fe5a28 (current head per context.json); use op.batch_alter_table for SQLite (add sub_categories table, then on products drop fk_products_category_id + category_id and add sub_category_id + fk_products_sub_category_id). Backfill chain product->sub_category->category as needed.

Exception class names: app.services.product_service now defines ProductNotFoundError, CategoryNotFoundError (kept, now UNUSED by product create/update but still importable), SubCategoryNotFoundError (new, message 'sub category id not found'), ProductHasActiveOrdersError. app.services.sub_category_service defines SubCategoryNotFoundError (message 'sub category not found') and SubCategoryNameExistsError (message 'sub category name already exists'); it imports CategoryNotFoundError from app.services.category_service for parent-category validation (message 'category id not found' on create/update; CategoryService.get_by_id still raises its own 'category not found').

ProductService methods added (thin passthroughs to ProductRepository): ProductService.get_by_sub_category_id(sub_category_id, sort_by='id', order='asc', page=1, limit=10) and ProductService.get_by_category_id(category_id, sort_by='id', order='asc', page=1, limit=10). ProductRepository gained matching get_by_sub_category_id (filter sub_category_id + is_active) and get_by_category_id (join Product->SubCategory on sub_category_id==id, filter SubCategory.category_id==id and both is_active). ProductRepository.create/update now use sub_category_id; get_all filter key is 'sub_category_id'.

Endpoint query-param handling: both new product-listing endpoints reuse ProductQuerySchema (location='query') so they accept name/sub_category_id/seller_id/min_price/max_price/sort_by(id,name,price,created_at)/order(asc,desc)/page/limit; they only pass sort_by/order/page/limit through to the service. Routes: GET /api/v1/sub-categories/<int:sub_category_id>/products (SubCategoryProducts, public; 404 if sub category missing) and GET /api/v1/categories/<int:category_id>/products-by-category (CategoryProductsByCategory, public; 404 if category missing), both returning ProductResponseSchema(many=True) + paginate_meta. Sub-category CRUD lives at /api/v1/sub-categories/ (url_prefix, blueprint name 'sub_categories'); POST/PUT/DELETE guarded by @roles_required('seller','admin'); POST/PUT catch CategoryNotFoundError->404 and SubCategoryNameExistsError->409.

Serialization: ProductDetailResponseSchema now emits 'sub_category' (SubCategoryInProductSchema: id, name, category_id, nested category) instead of 'category'. products.py routes now catch SubCategoryNotFoundError (not CategoryNotFoundError) on create/update. Category.to_dict_detail now includes 'sub_categories'; Category.to_dict_with_products gathers products through active sub_categories. SubCategory model has to_dict (id,name,category_id,created_at,is_active) and to_dict_detail (adds nested category). Tests: product payloads must use sub_category_id; conftest needs a seed_sub_categories fixture and products seeded with sub_category_id; clear_tables must delete products before sub_categories before categories.
